Future<void> run(items, read) async {
 final groups = items.slices(1);
 for (final batch in groups) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait(batch.map(read));
 }
 var mutable = items.slices(1);
 for (final batch in mutable) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait(batch.map(read));
 }
 final wide = items.slices(4);
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
 for (final batch in wide) { await Future.wait(batch.map(read)); }
}
